exposure: Major adverse events (life-threatening events without a documented new arrhythmia)
outcome: Serious complications following acute medical therapy
cohort: 157 neonates/infants (< 1 year old) presenting with symptomatic non-postoperative supraventricular tachycardias between 2000 and 2015
finding: Non-postoperative supraventricular tachycardia in neonates and infants is associated with serious complications and acute intravenous pharmacological treatment to control tachycardia may pose a risk for fatal or near-fatal outcomes.
birth_weight: Lower in patients with complications or death
